cases.prompt: Generate a seamless 128x128 mossy stone floor tile. Its opposite edges must connect in a repeated square grid, without visible seams or sudden color/lighting gradient jumps. Keep it flat, with no raised front wall. Deliver an opaque 128x128px tile with local ground-center anchor (64,64). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Flat screen-aligned top-down ground square with no raised front wall, tilt, diamond-grid rotation, or perspective convergence.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.seam-continuity: Inspect 3x3 and 5x5 repeats at native and 2x scale: patterns connect across every horizontal/vertical join, with no grid lines or discontinuous gradients. Exact edge metrics alone do not establish seamlessness.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
